request.prompt: Candid high-end editorial portrait photograph, 3:4 vertical composition, of three clearly adult friends aged 30 to 45 with varied genders and ethnicities sharing a playful, connected moment at a modern upscale roulette table. One friend lightly gestures toward a place on the felt while the others recognize the choice with warm smiles; focus on their faces, hands, and interaction. The roulette wheel and a small ordinary group of chips provide necessary context but remain secondary, softly focused, and never glamorous; all wheel and table numerals must be too blurred or obscured to read. Intentional warm cinematic key light, well-exposed natural skin, lifted shadows, subtle amber highlights, realistic candid body language, premium hospitality editorial quality. Compose for a centered 3:4 crop with at least 10% breathing room around faces and hands. No minors, no alcohol, no cash stacks, no solitary players, no distress, no brands, no logos, no watermarks, no readable screens, no readable symbols or text in the image.
